question: What do the remaining three quarters of SimEx_RootLayerLogic implement, beyond the speed modifiers (L4016) and the dive, slide and vault start rules (L4022)?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/root-part-3.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Stance (0xa2c0 to 0xad78): a change between prone and stand or crouch starts a 0..1 timer advancing by frame time / `TransitionInputBlockTime`; `TransitionInputBlock` is true until it completes.
Prone entry (0xe4a4): requires not `ZipLineAttach`, not `HangingRopeAttached`, and `ProneAllowed_PerTeam` (AI: `AI_ProneAllowed_PerTeam`). Stance values 0, 1, 2 read as stand, crouch, prone.
Stance override (0xf3a4): `StanceOverride` value 7 means none; otherwise it sets the physics shape.
Swimming depth bands: thresholds 0.2, 0.6, 1.2 with a 0.2 s hold in the newer classifier; 0.25, 0.8, 1.5 in the legacy one.

Parachute (0x22964, 0x387a0): `Parachute.InCooldown` until 0.6 s after `Parachute.TimeSinceCut` and only in actions 1, 11, 25, 27; auto-deploy when ground distance is between `Parachute.AutoDeploy.DistanceToGround` - 1.5 (or 5.0 during insertion) and + 1.0; armed by a downward probe of length 0.8 x 150.
Slide clock (0x2a8a0): `TimeSinceLastDiveOrSlide` counts up to 10 and pauses in actions 13 and 25; slide state gate is action 0, or 1 or 12 outside certain fall-speed bands.

Vault window (0x3e288): while `InAirFromJump`, maximum height = `Vault_StartHeightMax` (forward or idle) or `Vault_StartHeightMaxDirectional` (other directions) minus clamp(height now - `LastJumpHeight`, -0.25, 0.67); obstacle height bands at 1.9, and 0.9 and 1.4, pick the vault variant; inputs are clamped to +-0.99 with a 0.1 dead zone.

Slide input (0x3a980): with the slide input held, slide if `TargetStance` is 0 or 1; otherwise `OptionSlideOnCrouchNetworked` chooses crouch toggle, crouch hold, or both. The moving test includes prone speed above 1.5 and excludes steep slopes.
Prone movement is limited by obstacle and ground probes (three inlined copies); detail in the findings file.

inference: Action numbers (1, 11, 12, 13, 25, 27) are raw values; their names are not in the listing.
`b569d9f2` reads across graphs as a test that the owner has a given upgrade or trait.
`3042c4bd` reads as greater-or-equal, `e6117a11` as less-than, `7bec9f8f` as subtract, `c58d8ea6` as frame time.
unresolved: Stance-selector switch tables (0xae20 to 0xf34c) are not decoded.
Geometry probes and several subroutine calls are undecoded operations.
L4022 read the jump adjustment clamp as 0..1 in an earlier copy of the vault code; this later copy uses -0.25..0.67. Both constants exist; which copy is live is not established.
Tunable values are named here but stored elsewhere.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Rest of the root soldier graph read: prone needs the per-team mutator and no zipline or rope, stance changes to and from prone block input for a tunable time, the parachute has a 0.6 s cooldown and an auto-deploy window of -1.5 to +1 around a tunable, vault height is reduced by clamp(height gained since jump, -0.25, 0.67), and slide input follows the crouch option
leads.summary: Parts 1, 3 and 4 of the root soldier graph were read. Prone is allowed only with the per-team mutator and when not on a zipline or rope; changing between prone and standing or crouching blocks input for `TransitionInputBlockTime`. Water depth is classed in five bands (0.2, 0.6, 1.2; legacy 0.25, 0.8, 1.5). The parachute has a 0.6 s cooldown after a cut and auto-deploys inside a window of -1.5 to +1 around a tunable distance. Vault maximum height is reduced by the height gained since the jump, clamped to -0.25..0.67. Slide input depends on the slide-on-crouch option. 18 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: The switch instruction and the geometry operations are decoded, or the tunable values are joined.
